title: Intradermal Coinfection of Mice Ears with L. major IA-2 and Staphylococcus aureus Newman Strain
author: Tiffany Borbon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vdse26e

steps.title: Gather required materials
steps.instruction: Collect all reagents, equipment, and supplies listed in the Materials section, including 6‑8‑week‑old female C57Bl/6 mice, S. aureus Newman, L. major IA‑2, sterile tryptic soy broth (TSB) and agar plates, Schneider’s Drosophila medium with supplements, 40 % and 10 % Ficoll‑Paque PLUS solutions, ketamine (80 mg/kg) and xylazine (10 mg/kg), 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes, 27‑gauge ½‑inch 1 mL needles, thickness gage, caliper and ruler, 0.37 × 12.7 mm insulin syringe, 15 mL or 50 mL conical tubes or plastic tubing, PBS, spectrophotometer, 37 °C incubators (shaking and static), and a permanent marker.

steps.title: Prepare S. aureus culture
steps.instruction: Grow and dilute S. aureus Newman to the required CFU concentrations for injection.

substeps.instruction: Day –2: Streak a TSA plate with S. aureus Newman MSSA and incubate overnight (O/N) at 37 °C.
Day –1: Pick an isolated colony and inoculate into 5 mL TSB; incubate with shaking at 37 °C O/N.
Day 0 – Subculture 250 µL of the overnight culture into 25 mL fresh TSB; grow 1.5–2 h in a 37 °C shaking incubator until OD ≈0.5.
Transfer 10 mL of this culture into a 50 mL conical tube containing 40 mL PBS and centrifuge at 3500 rpm for 10 min.
Resuspend the pellet in sterile PBS to a concentration of 1 × 10⁵ CFU/mL (spectrophotometer calibration: OD 1 = 3 × 10⁸ CFU/mL = 3 × 10⁵ CFU/µL).
Dilute on ice to:
• 2 × 10³ CFU/µL (5 µL gives 10⁴ CFU) for mixing 1:1 with L. major (final injection: 10⁶ parasites + 10⁴ CFU S. aureus).
• 1 × 10³ CFU/µL (10 µL gives 10⁴ CFU) for S. aureus‑only injection (10⁴ CFU).
Plate serial dilutions of each inoculum on TSA plates; incubate O/N at 37 °C and count colonies to confirm dose.

steps.title: Prepare L. major metacyclics
steps.instruction: Isolate and dilute L. major IA‑2 metacyclic promastigotes for injection.

substeps.instruction: Harvest 30 mL of 3–5‑day‑old L. major IA‑2 cultures grown in Schneider’s medium.
Separate metacyclic parasites by density‑gradient centrifugation using 40 % and 10 % Ficoll‑Paque PLUS as described by Spath & Beverley (2001).
Wash parasites in PBS.
Resuspend in PBS at:
• 2 × 10⁵ parasites/µL (5 µL provides 10⁶ parasites) for 1:1 mixing with S. aureus (final injection: 10⁶ parasites + 10⁴ CFU S. aureus).
• 1 × 10⁵ parasites/µL (10 µL provides 10⁶ parasites) for L. major‑only injection (10⁶ parasites).

steps.title: Anesthetize mice
steps.instruction: Administer ketamine/xylazine mixture intraperitoneally to achieve surgical anesthesia.

substeps.instruction: Prepare ketamine (80 mg/kg) and xylazine (10 mg/kg) in PBS.
Inject the calculated volume intraperitoneally using a 27‑gauge ½‑inch 1 mL needle.

steps.title: Measure ear dimensions
steps.instruction: Record baseline ear thickness and lesion size before injection.

substeps.instruction: Use the Mitutoyo flat‑anvil dial thickness gage (0–22 mm, 0.01 mm increments) to measure right‑ear thickness.
Measure lesion width and length with a caliper and ruler.

steps.title: Load injection syringe
steps.instruction: Prepare a 0.37 × 12.7 mm insulin syringe with 10 µL of the appropriate inoculum.

substeps.instruction: Load PBS, L. major alone, S. aureus alone, or the 1:1 L. major + S. aureus mixture as required.

steps.title: Perform intradermal ear injection
steps.instruction: Inject 10 µL into the right ear pinna using proper support and technique.

substeps.instruction: Place a 15 mL or 50 mL conical tube (or a piece of plastic tubing) against the mouse ear to act as a backstop.
Insert the insulin syringe needle bevel‑up so it is visible under the skin.
Deliver 10 µL intradermally; a visible bubble at the site confirms successful inoculation.

steps.title: Mark and record mouse data
steps.instruction: Identify each mouse and log anesthesia details.

substeps.instruction: Mark the mouse tail with a permanent marker to denote experimental group.
Record the amount of ketamine administered and note the time of loss and recovery of anesthesia.

steps.title: Monitor infection progression
steps.instruction: Measure lesion size and ear thickness at defined time points.

substeps.instruction: Using a caliper, measure lesion area and ear thickness on days 1–7, 14, 21, and 28, and then weekly if desired.

steps.title: Euthanize and collect tissues
steps.instruction: Terminate the experiment and harvest samples according to IACUC guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize mice by CO₂ asphyxiation followed by cervical dislocation.
Harvest injected ears, draining cervical/submandibular lymph nodes, and any other organs needed for downstream analyses.
Package the carcasses for incineration according to institutional protocol.
